observations.issue: The locale has two renderings: “Canvas” (ui.chat.canonical.supplement.file_actions.open_in_canvas, ui.common.file_actions.show_in_canvas, and this batch's ui.chat.composer.tip.canvas) and “khung vẽ” (ui.command_palette.use_palette_sources.open_canvas/close_canvas, ui.mesh.mesh_page.canvas, ui.shell.rail.canvas.aria/aria_count/tooltip/tooltip_count).
observations.recommendation: Resolve locale-wide, not in this key. Carried from round 1; not a finding against the batch.

observations.issue: 21 values render asset as “tệp” (library cluster and the new viewer keys), but ui.projects.project_updates.show_asset_name renders it as “tài sản” (property/wealth). The new viewer keys use the correct cluster; the outlier is pre-existing.
observations.recommendation: Fix ui.projects.project_updates.show_asset_name in a separate terminology pass; do not propagate “tài sản” into the viewer. Carried from round 1.

observations.issue: ui.chat.directory.folder.home = “Thư mục chính”, while macOS Vietnamese's generic Finder string for Home is “Nhà”. The descriptive label is clearer than the bare OS string and Finder's sidebar normally shows the account name.
observations.recommendation: Keep unless strict platform-string parity is required. Carried from round 1.
